I want to understand how NLP can be used to analyze large amounts of policy documents.
I would like to learn how governments can use NLP to extract information from administrative data.
I want to understand the basic concepts behind NLP without needing a computer science background.
How can NLP help us analyze open-ended survey responses?
I am interested in using NLP for public policy research.
I want to learn how text can be transformed into quantitative data for statistical analysis.
How can we identify topics in thousands of newspaper articles or policy documents?
I want to understand how sentiment analysis could be used to study public opinion.
I would like to learn how reliable NLP models are when applied to real-world policy data.
How can NLP help policymakers make sense of large amounts of unstructured information?
I want to learn the difference between traditional text analysis and modern AI approaches.
I am interested in learning how ChatGPT and other LLMs actually process text.
I want to understand what embeddings are and why they are useful for analyzing documents.
How can we use NLP to compare the content of different political speeches?
I would like to learn how to classify documents into policy categories automatically.
I want to understand the strengths and limitations of using AI for policy analysis.
How can NLP be used to analyze parliamentary debates?
I want to learn how topic modeling works and whether it can reveal unexpected themes in policy documents.
I am interested in using Python to analyze textual data.
I want to understand how preprocessing decisions affect the conclusions we draw from text data.
How can we analyze text when we have relatively small datasets?
I would like to learn how to work with multilingual or German-language policy documents.
I want to understand the difference between word counts, TF-IDF, and embeddings.
How can we measure similarity between policy documents?
I am interested in using NLP to study how policy issues change over time.
I want to learn how to extract names, organizations, locations, and other entities from text.
How can NLP be used to analyze citizen feedback?
I would like to understand how large language models differ from older machine learning methods.
I want to learn how to evaluate whether an NLP model is producing meaningful results.
I am interested in the ethical problems associated with using AI to analyze people's opinions.
How can NLP help researchers analyze qualitative data at scale?
I want to understand how biased training data can affect NLP results.
I would like to learn how to use pretrained models rather than building everything from scratch.
How can we use NLP to identify narratives or frames in political communication?
I want to learn about the practical applications of NLP in government and public administration.
I am interested in how LLMs can be used as research assistants and what their limitations are.
How can we analyze very short responses, such as answers to survey questions?
I want to understand how transformers work at a conceptual level.
I would like to learn how to combine NLP with conventional statistical analysis.
How can NLP be used to monitor public discourse around a particular policy issue?
I want to learn how to build a simple NLP workflow from collecting text through to interpreting the results.
I am interested in whether NLP can help identify misinformation or misleading claims.
How can we make sure that automated text analysis does not oversimplify complex social issues?
I want to understand when an NLP approach is appropriate for a research question and when it is not.
I would like to learn how to visualize large collections of text and the relationships between documents.
How can NLP be used to support evidence-based policymaking?
I want practical experience working with real-world textual datasets rather than only theoretical examples.
I am interested in the relationship between NLP, machine learning, and generative AI.
I want to understand how much we can trust outputs from LLMs when using them for policy research.
Overall, I want to learn enough NLP to critically assess and use these methods in my future policy work.
